releases.title: Commentary everywhere
changes: Church Fathers commentary expanded to 60,376 entries from 55 fathers, drawn from their own scripture citations.
Commentary now loads without any download, and can be saved offline as a pack from Library → Downloads.
The app itself is much smaller: the bundled database dropped from 307 MB to 165 MB.
Hand-picked and Legacy commentary are now separate collections you switch between.

releases.title: Patristic commentary rebuilt, and ESV
changes: Verse-by-verse commentary rebuilt from the fathers' own citations, replacing the previous dataset.
Daily reading notifications.
Morphology parsing and display fixes, including Berean Standard Bible Psalms.
Fixed verses failing to load on a cold start.
ESV translation support — bring your own free Crossway API key from Settings.

releases.title: Reading plans and the home-screen widget
changes: Reading plans with progress tracking.
Android home-screen widget.
Early church study features: councils, creeds, canon formation, persecutions, and a geographic map of the fathers.
Greek Old Testament word study now works without downloading a pack.
Startup translation setting, and search now routes correctly to downloaded packs.

releases.title: Downloadable content packs
changes: Content pack system: 50+ optional downloads for translations, apocrypha, early Christian texts, and original-language sources.
Redesigned Downloads tab with grouping, bulk removal, and download-all.
Cross-references can now be sorted in biblical order.
KJV+ Strong's improvements and numerous fixes.

releases.title: Study tools
changes: Split passage view and focus mode.
Space saver display option.
Strong's translation variants modal.
Schisms panel, improved search ranking, and a skippable onboarding tour.
Concordance accuracy improvements.

releases.title: Original languages and red letters
changes: Red letter text for the words of Christ.
Greek and Hebrew search.
Parallel translations and parallel Strong's.
Font family picker and per-scope text settings.
Church fathers commentary with the map panel.

releases.title: Notes, cross-references and history
changes: Per-verse notes, plus a Notes tab listing them in biblical order.
Cross-references tab and verse sharing.
Reading history.
Historical tab in the Study screen.
Performance improvements across the main screens.
